subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the repository accept these 14 action upgrades after the required Codex-action contract inspection and an exact-head workflow validation of privileged release/token paths?
rationale: The PR changes third-party action code executed with credentials and release authority; determining whether the upgraded contracts remain acceptable requires repository-owner judgment beyond a routine Dependabot diff review.

options.title: Validate then merge
options.body: Rebase the branch, inspect the v1.11 Codex action behavior against sibling `../codex`, and accept the updates once the refreshed privileged workflow evidence is satisfactory.

options.title: Split sensitive action upgrades
options.body: Land routine official GitHub/Docker action upgrades separately and defer the Codex or credential-handling action updates for a narrower security review.

options.title: Pause the group update
options.body: Hold this grouped Dependabot PR if its combined privileged-workflow blast radius is not worth validating as one change.

recommendation.title: Validate then merge
recommendation.body: Rebase the branch, inspect the v1.11 Codex action behavior against sibling `../codex`, and accept the updates once the refreshed privileged workflow evidence is satisfactory.

likelyOwner.reason: Likely closest decision owner for repository-wide workflow, release, and Codex-agent policy; attribution confidence is limited without local history access.
